title: Read the signed-in user of each installed Vault
summary: Lists every installed Vault (workspace) with the signed-in user's full name and GUID from IEDMS_Vault.GetUserDetails, and optionally the server manager's user from IEDMS_DXPServerManager.GetUserInfo.
phrasings: get the current user's name in Altium 365
list installed workspaces and who is signed in
read the user GUID of a workspace
find which workspaces I am logged in to

commands.name: GetUserInfo
commands.description: Show the signed-in user of each installed Vault
commands.params: Vault=<index, optional: only that Vault>|Server=<true: also the server manager's user, optional>
